Eleven comments

“Her Golden Hair Was Curling Down” ~ from the playing of John Brosnan

This is from one of our favourite box albums, “John Brosnan: The Cook in the Kitchen”. I have an old cassette that has travelled with me, in our old vans and buses. Now we have only a CD player in our car. I’ll have to chase up the CD now. The cassette is well worn and suffers as you might expect from repeated playing in all kinds of weather, from sub zero to sub Saharan… If you haven’t heard this lovely box player, do your damnedest to chase this recording up and add it to your collection…

↳ Posted by ceolachan on March 14th, 2008.

Before someone shouts ‘dupication’

Music Hall hit of the 1890s

This is a fling setting of “And Her Golden Hair Was Curling Down Her Back,” a music hall hit of the 1890s composed by the Irishman Felix McGlennon. Monroe Rosenfeld copyrighted a schottische arrangement for piano. It was a slightly bawdy number about a shy village girl who went to London and came back “with a naughty little twinkle in her eye.”

↳ Posted by blarneystar on March 28th, 2008.

Her Golden Hair Was Curling Down, X:6

I have amended bar 1 of line 4 in version 4 above. This is basically how it is played on Connie O‘Connell’s album ’Ceol Cill na Martra‘ where it follows the ’Forgotten fling‘ on track 1. He calls it ’Her golden hair was curling down in ringlets’.

Her golden hair hung down in ringlets

Her Golden Hair Was Curling Down, X:7

A hornpipe with no name given to one his pupils by Padraig O’Keeffe. A copy of the manuscript is in Dan Herlihy’s book published in 2003, page 40 tune 2.

↳ Posted by brailsford on December 9th, 2021.

Re: Golden Hair

POK gave this tune to at least two other pupils, and the settings are both slightly different in the turn. In particular they have e’s substituted for the c’s in bar 4, which brings them into line with most current versions.
https://www.itma.ie/digital-library/score/padraig-okeeffe-ms-bk-3-56 and
https://www.itma.ie/digital-library/score/padraig_okeeffe_oconnell_ms_052
The latter pupil was rewarded with a name: Golden Hair.

↳ Posted by brailsford on December 9th, 2021.
